central_question: What does the addressed rate show about developer response to Copilot code review, and what does it leave unresolved?
claims_and_limits: The new copilot_code_review object appears in enterprise and organization repos-1-day rows; comments are evaluated when a PR merges.
The numerator includes applying a suggestion, requesting a Copilot fix, editing by hand or promising a later PR, so it does not establish defect remediation.
The human change-request count has a PR-level denominator and is separate from comment addressed rate; only Copilot PR comments enter the latter.

visual.shared_motif: Purple developer review workspace with an annotated pull request and paths representing developer responses; cover is a scene, inner image is a more detailed conceptual review board.
visual.status: Conceptual editorial illustration, not an API schema or an empirical scorecard. The human review branch is explicitly separate from the addressed-comment count.
